messages:
Nina: Drafting a compact customer-facing runbook for onboarding + renewal health checks. Aim: actionable steps for prefill/prefetch, conservative batching, streaming fallback UX, and a tiny feedback ping to surface early renewal risk. Can I get quick practical additions?

Raj: Love it. Keep it <1 page. For prefetch, suggest top-3 intents + a 60s TTL for small accounts. Add a short curl snippet folks can copy.

Raj: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/config \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -d '{"prefetch": {"enabled": true, "top_n": 3, "ttl_s": 60}}'
```

Devon: Ops notes: default batch size = 4 for new customers, let them raise to 8 as usage stabilizes. Include a short runbook: if p95 > 400ms for 10m -> reduce batch size to 2 and disable non-essential batching.

Elena: For streaming fallback UX: show a short toast "Slow connection — loading full result" and fall back to sync call. Log an event streaming_fallback=true so CS can see frequency.

Elena: Pseudo-flow:```text
client.request(stream=true)
if websocket error or connection close before first chunk:
  call /generate (sync)
  emit event: {streaming_fallback:true, reason: "ws_error"}
  client shows toast: "Slow connection — loading full result"
```

Nina: Nice. For feedback capture I want minimal friction: 2 yes/no micro-questions after the first successful call in a session (opt-in). Q1: "Was this answer useful?" Q2: "Would you use this more often?" Add a webhook example to send responses to CS queue.

Raj: Also surface sample failing prompts (redact email/SSNs) — export button in Console that pulls last 7 days of negative feedback and 10 sample prompts. Makes troubleshooting faster.

Devon: Monitoring checklist additions:
- KV cache hit rate target: > 55% first 48h for prefill
- Errors > 0.75% for 15m -> page SRE
- Streaming_fallback rate > 3% for 24h -> alert for network issues

Elena: Renewal-risk heuristic proposal: mark account yellow if (>=2 negative feedbacks in 7 days) OR (usage down 15% over 14d) OR (>=4 streaming fallbacks in 7 days). Escalate to CSM for outreach if two conditions true.

Nina: I will write the one-page runbook with this structure: 1) Quick TL;DR, 2) Copy-paste configs, 3) Runbook alerts & thresholds, 4) UX fallback steps, 5) Feedback capture + webhook, 6) Renewal flags + escalation.

Raj: I'll add the curl and console export instructions.

Devon: I'll produce the alert rules and small warmup script (100 quick prompts).

Elena: I'll polish the customer-facing copy so it's non-technical. Suggest swapping "Was this answer useful?" -> "Did this help you?" for UX testing.

OnboardBot: [automated] Runbook draft created by Nina. Next steps: add to onboarding template, notify account SME, schedule review with SRE.

Nina: Thanks team. I'll drop the PR and ping for reviews. :rocket:
